derivation: SCOPE: declaration B of the champion gate. It covers only R2: --n2-equivalence --n2-k 3 --block-invariance on bank chunk 0 of the D3 bank the cited measurements read (4073 roots, the same 11-call split: buckets 512, 32 and 8), at the mode's own shapes. Those are --capacity 512 --block-lanes 2187 --oracle-chunk 512, DepthNPricer N=2 at full width and top-3 without fixed capacity (the parser refuses --fixed-shapes with --n2-equivalence), and Depth2Pricer at child_block 27 and 81, as the measurement priced them. R1 and R3 are covered by declaration A (champion-9375-bf16-r1r3-20261107.json); a run on other roots compiles other buckets and is not covered. CONSTRUCTION, the same as declaration A's. For each gated float site, the run compares two bf16 geometries A and B, so |A - B| <= (|A_bf16 - f32| + adapter) + (|B_bf16 - f32| + adapter), where adapter = 1e-5 for values and 1e-4 for logits. Each side is measured at the exact positions the site compares; the gate oracle side is sampled, so that site takes max(P_all + O_sample, 2 x P_all). (e)'s completed Q is computed through the gate's own decide_roots and backups, over roots whose selection matches between bf16 and f32. Each field = 1.25 x its largest site tail, rounded up to 2 significant figures: value_bound 1.25 x 0.02055 (R2.top3.n2.floats.t2_value) -> 0.026; turn1_logit_bound 1.25 x 0.5019 (R2.full_width.n2.floats.t1_own_logits) -> 0.63; root_logit_bound 1.25 x 0.2076 (R2.full_width.n2.floats.root_peer_logits) -> 0.26; near_tie_q_bound = 1.25 x max(value tail 0.02055, dQ tail 0.02159 (R2.top3.n2.e)) -> 0.027. deeper_logit_bound 0.87 is declaration A's: the schema requires a deeper bound, and R2 (depth 2) has no ply >= 2 priors, so it is never applied. (1) R2.full_width.n2.e: its f32 premise (DepthN N=2 f32 against Depth2Pricer f32 Q) was not measured, because piece b ran on tool 6767fe6c, before that check existed. Per the lead's cap there is no new measurement. n2's exact checks (discrete arrays, digests, world reports) fix the tree and its inputs. The numeric cover is the measured full-width f32 n2 comparison: the two f32 frames' logits are bit-equal, their turn-1 values differ by 0 and their leaves by at most 3.3e-7, on top of discrete equality. depth2_backups is 1-Lipschitz in the values at fixed priors, so the f32 |dQ| is at most 3.3e-7, far inside 2 x the Q adapter bound (8.2e-4). The gate site measured directly on chunk 0 is 1.8e-7. The top-3 premise was measured. (2) Top-3: 25076 turn-2 positions where bf16 and f32 chose different children are excluded from the bf16-vs-f32 comparisons, counted and flagged. The run compares two bf16 frames on identical requests. Selection equality there comes from the exact t2_status and t2_digest checks.
